title: Exodus wallet vault
whyItMatters: The Exodus wallet folder holds the encrypted vault with the private keys for all of the person's coins. With the password it is the money; without it, it still proves what they owned.
source: Exodus knowledge base, the wallet data folder is exodus.wallet inside the Exodus app-data folder: https://www.exodus.com/support/
notes: Encrypted storage.seco files inside. Timestamped archives of earlier vaults sit in a Backups folder next to it under %APPDATA% Exodus, so the parent folder matters too.

cleanup.exportFirst: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup: the 12-word secret key for every wallet in Exodus, written down offline.
steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup before removing anything.
In Exodus, open Settings and remove the wallet once the secret key is written down.
Uninstall Exodus from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the wallet folder named in the plan, including any backups next to it.
cleanup.risk: Without the 12-word secret key the wallet cannot be restored and the funds are lost; this removes every local copy here.
cleanup.source: Exodus Knowledge Base, Backup and restore: https://www.exodus.com/support/
